files.description: A repeatable system for juggling ChatGPT, Claude, a coding tool, and a notes app without spending your day copy-pasting context between them.

files.title: You Can't Delegate to Something That Has No Name
files.description: Every agent you run acts as you: same keys, same logs, same name on the record. Until agents can be held accountable as themselves, delegation is impossible.

files.title: Agents Sound Done. That Is the Whole Problem.
files.description: AI agents are extraordinary at sounding finished, even when the work never happened. The scarce skill in the agent era is not producing output. It is knowing which output to trust.

files.title: The AI That Worked While You Slept
files.description: The models are already smart enough. What changes work is AI that keeps running while you are away, and it quietly turns your job from operator into manager.

files.title: Building the Agent Org
files.description: AI has finally made it possible to build a true agent organization — and it's shaping up to look a lot like a human org, with the human moving up a layer rather than out of the loop.

files.title: Your Engineers Got a Coworker. You Got a Chat Box.
files.description: Everyone pays for the same AI, yet engineers get two to three times more done while everyone else stays flat, and the difference is the kind of AI each was handed.

files.title: AI's Biggest Bottleneck Right Now: The Human Middleware
files.description: Eight AI agents, all individually capable, none of them talking to each other. The bottleneck isn't intelligence — it's the human sitting in the middle, copying context between windows.

files.title: Memory Is the Past. State Is the Present.
files.description: AI tools finally remember what happened, but none of them can see what every other tool is doing right now, which is why running a dozen agents still feels broken.

files.title: You Won't Have One AI Agent. You'll Have Twelve.
files.description: The future of AI isn't one super-agent or multiple agents on one platform. It's multi-agent AND multi-platform - and the infrastructure for it is already being built by competitors who agreed to share the plumbing.

files.title: The Seam Nobody Built: Where Humans and AI Agents Hand Off Work
files.description: Agents alone are solved and humans alone always worked. The unbuilt layer is the hand-off, where a person and an agent trade the same work back and forth.

files.title: What Is an AI Agent?
files.description: The clearest explanation of what AI agents are, how they actually work, and what makes them different from every AI tool you've used before.

files.title: You're Not Behind on AI. Almost Nobody Is.
files.description: AI FOMO says everyone is racing ahead of you. A hundred real conversations say otherwise: almost no one has figured this out yet, and that is the opportunity.
